scenes.text: In pattern card 1, one equal piece of a shape cut into 2 equal parts is which fraction? Let us think carefully. A unit fraction is one of 2 equal parts. The answer is 1/2. Great work!
In pattern card 2, one equal piece of a shape cut into 3 equal parts is which fraction? Let us think carefully. A unit fraction is one of 3 equal parts. The answer is 1/3. Great work!
In pattern card 3, one equal piece of a shape cut into 4 equal parts is which fraction? Let us think carefully. A unit fraction is one of 4 equal parts. The answer is 1/4. Great work!
In pattern card 4, one equal piece of a shape cut into 5 equal parts is which fraction? Let us think carefully. A unit fraction is one of 5 equal parts. The answer is 1/5. Great work!
